### Filter

```{ojs}
viewof clearFilters = Inputs.button("Clear filters")
```

```{ojs}
viewof filters = {
  clearFilters;   // re-run (and so reset) this form whenever "Clear filters" is clicked
  const projIds = [...new Set(data.flatMap(d => d.projects))].sort();
  const extra = projIds.length
    ? {projects: Inputs.select(projIds, {label: "Project", multiple: true, format: id => projectName.get(id) ?? id})}
    : {};
  return P.filterForm(data, filterCols, extra);
}
```

## Get the data

```{ojs}
codePanels = P.codePanels([meta.id], new Map([[meta.id, meta]]), {headings: false, fileStem: () => meta.id})
```

```{ojs}
{
  P.assignRows(codePanels, codeRows);
  if (!codeRows.length) return md`*No datapoints match the filters.*`;
  return html`<small>Code for ${selection.length ? "ticked rows" : "all filtered rows"}.</small>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
P.csvDownload(
  codeRows,
  ["datapoint_name", "plot", "site", "lat", "lon", "date", "projects", ...publicCols.map(c => c.column)],
  labelOf,
  `${meta.id}_metadata.csv`,
  {projects: v => (v ?? []).join(";")}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {makePortal} from "../assets/portal.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// ---- Libraries -------------------------------------------------------------------
leaflet = require("leaflet@1.9.4")

Mustache = {
  const mod = await require("mustache@4.2.0");
  const m = mod.default ?? mod;
  m.escape = s => String(s);   // we are generating code, not HTML: never escape
  return m;
}

P = makePortal({d3, Inputs, html, DOM, leaflet, Mustache})

// ---- Data written by build.R -----------------------------------------------------
meta     = FileAttachment("../_generated/datatypes/dna_sequencing.json").json()
raw      = FileAttachment("../_generated/datatypes/dna_sequencing.csv").csv()
links    = FileAttachment("../_generated/project_links.csv").csv()
overview = FileAttachment("../_generated/projects_overview.csv").csv()

// ---- Columns -----------------------------------------------------------------------
colInfo    = P.normalizeColumns(meta.columns)
cols       = colInfo.cols
publicCols = colInfo.publicCols
filterCols = colInfo.filterCols

sharedLabels = ({
  datapoint_name: meta.shared_labels?.datapoint_name ?? "Name",
  plot: "Plot", site: "Site", date: "Date", lat: "Latitude", lon: "Longitude", projects: "Projects"
})
labelOf = col => sharedLabels[col] ?? cols.find(c => c.column === col)?.label ?? col

tableCols = {
  const shown = P.asArray(meta.display?.table);
  const cs = shown.length ? [...shown]
    : ["datapoint_name", "plot", "site", "date", ...publicCols.map(c => c.column)];
  if (!cs.includes("projects")) cs.push("projects");
  return cs;
}

// ---- Rows ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
projectName   = new Map(overview.map(p => [p.id, p.name]))
projectsByUid = d3.rollup(links.filter(l => l.datatype === meta.id),
                          v => v.map(l => l.project_id), l => l.uid)

data = P.prepareRows(raw, cols, {merge: r => ({projects: projectsByUid.get(r.uid) ?? []})})

filtered = data.filter(d =>
  P.matches(d, filters, filterCols) &&
  (!filters.projects?.length || filters.projects.some(p => d.projects.includes(p))))

codeRows = selection.length ? selection : filtered
```
